title: Rehearsing in the studio
summary: They rehearsed minutes at the studio, contrary to the claims of careful rehearsal.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Making records: studios, takes and the technology

blocks.x: How much rehearsing did you do for those records? Huh? How much rehearsing did you do for those records?
Oh, we didn't rehearse much. We rehearsed right in the studio before we started. Say about... 4 to 5 minutes per hour at the most of it. Eight numbers.
Really? And that went for jelly rolls. Famous records that everybody says were so well rehearsed. Ha!
